slices.name: Humpty Dumpty
slices.note: known (corrected in version 5): the cell-first section of the 600-cell at height 1 + sqrt5/2, one of the sections drawn by Alicia Boole Stott (1900, cell-first series through the corner layers), read for #63 version 3; the exact solid, the convex egg of 92 triangles (Td) and the name are #63's and DICTO's; D85 is kept (D-numbers are never reused); its forced equal-edged form is Fallen Humpty (#63; Slice-48 in #62, numeric only, not in the dataset)
slices.scale_note: frame: the 600-cell of #62/#63 (vertices the permutations of (+-2, 0, 0, 0), (+-1, +-1, +-1, +-1) and the even permutations of (+-phi, +-1, +-1/phi, 0); circumradius 2, edge sqrt5 - 1), cut by the 3-space at height 1 + sqrt5/2 along the cell-first direction d = the centre of the cell (0, 24, 25, 40) = (7/8 + 3sqrt5/8, 3/8 + sqrt5/8, 0, 1/4). Coordinates: the imaginary part of the quaternion product conj(d) p of each point p of the cut, which is the slice turned into R^3 (centre at the origin) and scaled by |d| = sqrt((7 + 3sqrt5)/4) = 1.8512: the scale at which the slice is exact in Q(sqrt5) (unscaled, an orthonormal frame needs sqrt(7 + 3sqrt5) as well). Divide lengths by |d| and squared lengths by 7/4 + 3sqrt5/4 for the 600-cell of circumradius 2. Humpty Dumpty: 48 corners (12 of degree 8, 36 of degree 5), 138 edges of eight lengths (ratio up to (5 + sqrt5)/2), 92 triangles; tetrahedral symmetry Td (#63 section 7).
